'''Rordis City''' was a major [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]]. The city was the site of a [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] factory.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
